7–12 years of experience, with a significant portion in the corporate lending domain; Techno-functional background preferred.

* Plan and coordinate product releases and upgrades with Product Engineering teams.
* Own the change control process for the product.
* Support sales and pre-sales efforts with domain expertise and competitive differentiation.
